body.x: Gary Shapiro, President of the CEA was interviewed by AVING News at the CES 2014, the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

"This event gathers every category related to innovations, such as music, broadcasts, cable, technologies of course. A world is expanding categories, including robotics, 3D printing, wireless, all of electronics, tablets, and smartphones" said Gary Shapiro, President of the CEA. He also gave some advice to small and medium-sized businesses from South Korea.
"If you want to build your own brand, expose yourself to retailers, buyers, and media and get feedback seeing people face to face with 5 senses." explained Gary Shapiro.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
